An open card keeps clear of the sheets beside it

1440 px window: the card narrows (1360 → 980 px) and the Chat is fully visible and usable

1000 px window: no room for both, so the Chat lies over the card, still usable

1200 px window with the left menu pinned and the Chat open: the card starts right of the menu and never covers it (the Chat lies over its right edge)

Pinning the menu while a card is open: the card is open beside Chat, the menu is pinned from the ☰ list…

…and the card moves right at once, clear of the pinned menu

Opening the inbox while a card is open: the card moves right of the inbox's list, the menu stays pinned and the Chat lies over the card's edge
